source: TL2 summaries of public reporting; each item links to its source.

items.headline: White House names its intelligence chief to lead its new AI task force
items.line: NPR reports President Trump named Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton to lead a new "Super Intelligence Force" that will coordinate the federal government's work with AI companies and other groups.

items.headline: Gemini 4 Argon's opening price doubles after launch
items.line: Google says Argon starts at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, rising to $4 and $20 after an introductory period; early access is limited to cyber defenders and trusted testers.

items.headline: Report: Oracle signs a $7 billion, five-year compute deal with Tencent
items.line: Citing the Financial Times, The Next Web says the roughly 100,000 chips sit in Oracle data centers in Southeast Asia, with about 30% paid upfront; the report is unconfirmed.
